newsitem.title: CHINA: Hong Kong air cargo rises 13 pct in April.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong air cargo rises 13 pct in April.

text.p: Hong Kong recorded a 13 percent rise in the total amount of air cargo loaded and unloaded at Kai Tak airport during May compared with the same month last year, latest regional statistics from the Civil Aviation Department show.

As in April, cargo to and from Taiwan showed the largest year on year increase up 25 per cent following a 37 per cent rise in April. Cargo to and from the United Kingdom, the Middle East and Japan all showed rises of 19 percent.
The only market to again record a fall was of 2 percent to and from the marginal market of South America.
The total amount of air cargo imports from around the world during May was 73,915 tonnes while the total amount of Hong Kong exports reached 72,290 tonnes.
